evidence.quote: a protective film covering a sensor part and a gate insulating film of a thin film transistor are formed of the same layer

flattening the surface of the insulating film with a silicon oxide film by a spin-on-glass method, performing etch back, and removing a part of the silicon oxide film and a part of the insulating film

a developing process of developing the layer after the exposure. The method is characterized in that the developing process includes a second step of forming a pattern made of the photosensitive resin layer and a third process of removing a development residue, and further includes a rinsing process, at least between the second process and the third process, of removing a process liquid used in a preceding process
